title: OXXO apertura la barra 600 de andatti gourmet en Puebla
summary: En promedio, la compañía vende 30 cafés por tienda diariamente en todas sus presentaciones. Puebla de Zaragoza, Puebla, 24 de [...]Leer más... from OXXO apertura la barra 600 de andatti gourmet en Puebla
body_text: En promedio, la compañía vende 30 cafés por tienda diariamente en todas sus presentaciones. Puebla de Zaragoza, Puebla, 24 de julio de 2026. OXXO celebró en Puebla la apertura de la barra #600 de andatti gourmet a nivel nacional, ubicada en la tienda OXXO Los Fuertes (Av. Batallones de Zacapoaxtla 1, Lomas de Loreto, Puebla de Zaragoza), un paso que refleja cómo la marca continúa evolucionando para responder a consumidores que buscan mayor calidad, personalización y nuevas experiencias alrededor del café, manteniendo la cercanía y accesibilidad que caracterizan a OXXO. Las barras de andatti gourmet representan una evolución de la propuesta de café de OXXO, al ofrecer una experiencia de mayor especialización y variedad, con bebidas preparadas al momento y opciones para distintos gustos. En estos espacios, los consumidores pueden disfrutar de bebidas calientes y frías, opciones con y sin café, bebidas con base de nieve, malteadas y una amplia variedad de ingredientes y combinaciones que permiten personalizar cada experiencia. La elección de Puebla para celebrar esta apertura no es casualidad. El estado se ha consolidado como una región relevante para el desarrollo de andatti en el país, gracias a un consumidor dinámico, cada vez más interesado en propuestas diferenciadas, sabores innovadores y experiencias de consumo más sofisticadas, sin perder accesibilidad y cercanía. Este desarrollo también refleja la relevancia que la categoría ha tomado dentro del negocio. Actualmente, a nivel nacional, OXXO vende en promedio 30 cafés por tienda diariamente en todas sus presentaciones, consolidando a andatti como una de las propuestas de café con mayor presencia y cercanía en México. “Tenemos una convicción clara: acercar una experiencia de café de calidad a más personas. Queremos que nuestros consumidores puedan disfrutar de una propuesta que combine calidad, innovación y personalización, con una oferta que se adapte a sus gustos y estilos de vida. Con la apertura de nuestra barra número 600 de andatti gourmet en Puebla, reafirmamos nuestro compromiso de seguir creciendo y llevando esta experiencia, orgullosamente hecha en México, a más personas”, comentó Ximena Reynoard, Directora de Foodvenience de OXXO México. La expansión de andatti gourmet forma parte de la estrategia de OXXO para seguir fortaleciendo su propuesta de valor en el país y ofrecer nuevas formas de disfrutar el café, con experiencias de mayor especialización y variedad, manteniendo la cercanía con millones de personas todos los días. ### Acerca de FEMSA FEMSA es una empresa que genera valor económico y social por medio de empresas e instituciones y busca ser el mejor empleador y vecino de las comunidades en donde tiene presencia. Participa en la industria del comercio al detalle a través de la División Proximidad Américas, de la que forma parte OXXO, una cadena de tiendas de formato pequeño, y otros formatos minoristas relacionados, y Proximidad Europa, que incluye a Valora, nuestra unidad de retail europea que opera tiendas de conveniencia y foodvenience. En el comercio al detalle, FEMSA también participa a través de la División Salud que incluye farmacias y actividades relacionadas; Y en Spin, que incluye Spin by OXXO y Spin Premia, entre otras iniciativas de servicios financieros digitales. En la industria de bebidas participa operando Coca-Cola FEMSA, el embotellador de productos Coca-Cola más grande del mundo por volumen de ventas. A través de sus Unidades de Negocio emplea a más de 392 mil colaboradores en 18 países. FEMSA es miembro del Índice Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index y del Dow Jones Best-in-Class MILA Pacific Alliance Index, ambos de S&P Global; Índice FTSE4Good Emerging; Índice MSCI EM Latin America ESG Leaders; S&P/BMV Total México ESG, entre otros índices. Acerca de FEMSA Proximidad y Salud. La División Proximidad y Salud de FEMSA genera valor económico y social en los países donde está presente. Opera cadenas de pequeño formato en América Latina y Europa, entre ellas OXXO y Bara, además de estaciones de servicio bajo la marca OXXO GAS en México y, en Europa, tiendas de conveniencia y servicios de alimentos a través de Valora. FEMSA Salud opera destacadas cadenas de farmacias en Latinoamérica, entre ellas YZA, Farmacon y Moderna en México; Cruz Verde en Colombia y Chile; Fybeca y SanaSana en Ecuador; y Maicao en Chile, además de un laboratorio productor y mayorista de medicamentos. En total, cuenta con más de 4,000 unidades en los países donde tiene presencia. A través de sus diferentes unidades de negocio, la División Proximidad y Salud de FEMSA atiende diariamente a más de 13 millones de consumidores y genera empleo para más de 230 mil colaboradores en 13 países. Su compromiso con la inclusión, la diversidad y la sostenibilidad impulsa prácticas que buscan operar en equilibrio con el planeta, las comunidades y toda su cadena de valor.

title: BRP Wins Four Red Dot Design Awards, Including a Prestigious “Best of the Best”
summary: Valcourt, Quebec, July 10, 2026 – BRP Inc. (TSX/NASDAQ: DOO) stands out once again on the international stage with four Red Dot Awards, including a prestigious “Best of the Best” for the Sea-Doo Switch Fish— the most coveted award in one of the most influential design competitions.
body_text: Valcourt, Quebec, July 10, 2026 – BRP Inc. (TSX/NASDAQ: DOO) stands out once again on the international stage with four Red Dot Awards, including a prestigious “Best of the Best” for the Sea-Doo Switch Fish— the most coveted award in one of the most influential design competitions. This recognition confirms the power of design as BRP’s true signature, and highlights the excellence of its team which contributes to shaping the Company’s reputation worldwide. In July 2025, BRP made history by becoming the first Canadian team to receive the “Red Dot: Design Team of the Year” title. A year later, Denys Lapointe, Chief Design Officer at BRP, took the stage at the Red Dot Award ceremony in Germany to pass the trophy on to the 2026 winning team, concluding a landmark chapter for BRP and reinforcing the company’s standing among the world’s leading design organizations. “After having the honor of presenting this year’s ‘Red Dot: Design Team of the Year 2026’ title to our successors, I am particularly proud to see our team’s exceptional work continue to shine in the industry,” said Denys Lapointe, Chief Design Officer at BRP. “These accolades demonstrate the strength of our design vision, and being recognized by our peers internationally is a source of immense pride.” About the Awards Sea-Doo Switch Fish The Sea-Doo Switch Fish stands out at the top and wins the “Best of the Best” award. This pontoon quickly and easily transforms from a fishing boat into a recreational watercraft, thanks to its modular design. The system allows users to combine seats, storage compartments, and accessories, giving them the ability to build their own experience from nearly 100 different components. The jury praised the Sea-Doo Switch Fish as “an exceptionally comprehensive concept in which form, modularity, and graphics meld perfectly, making both usage scenarios feel equally convincing.” Can-Am Outlander MAX 6x6 This all-terrain vehicle (ATV) excels on the most extreme terrain thanks to its uncompromising traction and ruggedness. Its modular cargo bed and removable LinQ system offer total flexibility in organizing the cargo space, while its integrated handles and intuitive fasteners simplify every task. At the front, a wide, assertive silhouette—defined by its distinctive headlights—gives the vehicle a bold and powerful visual presence. “Designed for robustness, modularity, and adaptability, this ATV impresses with its powerful, functional style and visual presence.” – Red Dot Jury. Can-Am Outlander Electric This electric ATV ushers in a new era with a quiet, zero-emission riding experience. Its robust proportions, sculpted body, and redesigned front end—featuring a distinctive LED light signature and a 5-inch color display—reinforce its unique identity. The thoughtful ergonomics, modular seats, and integrated racks are all part of this same philosophy: every detail is designed to ensure that any task can be performed effortlessly. Can-Am Defender HD11 The interior design of the Can-Am Defender HD11’s cabin defies convention: abundant natural light, ergonomics thought out down to the smallest detail, and robust, easy-to-maintain materials. The exterior design features a front end that exudes character, with distinctive headlights that lend it a powerful, bold style. About BRP BRP Inc. is a global leader in the world of powersports products and powertrains, built on over 80 years of ingenuity, innovation, and intensive consumer focus. Through its portfolio of industry-leading and distinctive brands featuring Ski-Doo and Lynx snowmobiles, Sea-Doo watercraft and pontoons, Can-Am on- and off-road vehicles, Quintrex boats as well as Rotax engines for karts, recreational aircraft and jet boats, BRP unlocks exhilarating adventures and provides access to experiences across different playgrounds. The Company completes its product lines with a dedicated parts, accessories and apparel portfolio to fully optimize the riding experience. Headquartered in Quebec, Canada, BRP had annual sales of CA$8.4 2 billion from over 110 countries and employed close to 17,000 driven, resourceful people as of January 31, 2026. www.brp.com LinkedIn Ski-Doo, Lynx, Sea-Doo, Can-Am, Rotax, Quintrex and the BRP logo are trademarks of Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. or its affiliates. title: Understanding Stress Leave: A Guide to Prioritizing Your Mental Health
summary: Struggling with work-related stress? Learn what to say to the doctor to get stress leave, recognize signs of burnout, and take an effective stress leave from work. Prioritize your mental health today!
body_text: The Concept of Stress Leave and Its Importance Stress leave is a period during which eligible employees take time off to address mental health issues caused by extreme stress. According to the American Institute of Stress , job stress costs U.S. businesses over $300 billion annually due to absenteeism and lost productivity [ source ]. Chronic stress can lead to serious health conditions, including high blood pressure, weakened immune function, and cognitive decline. Recognizing the effects of stress and utilizing available resources such as LunaJoy’s mental health services can help restore work-life balance and improve employee well-being. Why Acknowledging Stress Is the First Step in Addressing It Ignoring stress signals can worsen its impact on personal and professional life. According to the World Health Organization (WHO) , an estimated 15% of working-age adults experience a mental disorder at any given time. Depression and anxiety alone cause about 12 billion lost working days annually and cost the global economy roughly US $1 trillion in reduced productivity [ source ]. By identifying stress levels early, employees can seek support from LunaJoy’s counseling experts and take necessary steps to prevent occupational burnout. Signs of Burnout or Severe Stress at Work Recognizing severe stress is essential for timely intervention. Common indicators include: Physical Symptoms: Fatigue, headaches, digestive issues. Emotional Indicators: Irritability, anxiety, detachment from work. Cognitive Signs: Difficulty concentrating, declining productivity. If you notice these symptoms, consider speaking with a LunaJoy therapist for professional guidance. How to Take an Effective Stress Leave from Work 1. Assess Your Work Situation Evaluate how job stress is affecting your health. Heavy workloads, constant worry, and stressful work environments contribute to occupational burnout. Understanding the effects of stress helps in making an informed decision about taking stress leave. 2. Communicate with Your Employer Open communication with your employer is crucial. Discuss your health conditions and the need for stress leave. Be aware of company policies regarding stress leave and the benefits to employees. Providing a doctor's note can substantiate your request. 3. What to Say to the Doctor to Get Stress Leave When consulting a doctor, explain your symptoms clearly: Describe your stress levels and their impact on daily life. Mention physical symptoms such as high blood pressure or insomnia. Highlight any work-related stress that has worsened your condition. Request documentation if required for human resources. 4. Prepare for Your Absence Before starting your leave, ensure a smooth transition: Delegate tasks to colleagues. Inform clients about your temporary absence. Set up an out-of-office email response. 5. Take Care of Yourself During Stress Leave Use this time to focus on stress recovery. Engage in physical activity , practice time management skills , and participate in simple activities that promote relaxation. Seeking support from mental health professionals can also be beneficial. Ways to Transition Back to Work Without Feeling Overwhelmed Returning to a high-pressure work environment can be challenging. To ease this transition: Gradual Return: Start with part-time hours before resuming full-time duties. Open Dialogue: Maintain communication with human resources regarding your stress levels and accommodations. Implement Strategies: Apply stress management techniques learned during your leave. Prioritizing employee satisfaction and well-being leads to a more sustainable work-life balance. Conclusion Taking an effective stress leave from work involves recognizing the signs of severe stress , communicating with your employer, and utilizing time off to focus on your health. By addressing stress proactively, you can improve your overall mental health and return to work with renewed energy. Explore LunaJoy’s therapy and counseling services to support your mental wellness journey.

title: Rambus Enables Next-Generation AI and Data Center Platforms with DDR5 9600 Server RDIMM Chipset
summary: SAN JOSE, Calif. – July 8, 2026 – Rambus Inc. (NASDAQ: RMBS), a premier chip and silicon IP provider making data faster and safer, today announced its DDR5 9600 Server RDIMM chipset designed to deliver industry-leading memory performance for next-generation data center platforms. Built around the new Rambus 6th Generation Registering Clock Driver (RCD06) with a 20% increase in bandwidth over the prior generation, this complete chipset enables RDIMMs operating at up to 9600 MT/s, unlocking a new level of bandwidth and capacity required by agentic AI, high-performance computing (HPC) and other data-intensive workloads.
body_text: DDR5 9600 RDIMM chipset addresses rising memory performance and power management demands driven by AI and data-intensive workloads on advanced CPU-based servers Introduces new 6th Generation Registering Clock Driver (RCD06) operating at 9600 MT/s, a 20% increase in data rate over prior generation solution Offers complete chipset, including RCD06, PMIC5030 power management IC, SPD Hub and Temperature Sensor ICs, to simplify module development and speed time to market Enables breakthrough memory bandwidth, capacity and power efficiency for agentic AI, HPC and demanding data center workloads running on advanced CPU-based servers Figure 1: Rambus DDR5 9600 Server RDIMM Chipset SAN JOSE, Calif. – July 8, 2026 – Rambus Inc. (NASDAQ: RMBS), a premier chip and silicon IP provider making data faster and safer, today announced its DDR5 9600 Server RDIMM chipset designed to deliver industry-leading memory performance for next-generation data center platforms . Built around the new Rambus 6th Generation Registering Clock Driver (RCD06) with a 20% increase in bandwidth over the prior generation, this complete chipset enables RDIMMs operating at up to 9600 MT/s, unlocking a new level of bandwidth and capacity required by agentic AI, high-performance computing (HPC) and other data-intensive workloads. The accelerating evolution of AI from model training to large-scale inference and agentic workflows is driving a structural increase in server memory requirements. These workloads are highly iterative and memory-intensive, requiring significantly higher bandwidth and capacity for orchestration and execution. For large language model inference, techniques such as key-value (KV) caching further increase memory capacity and bandwidth requirements by storing and repeatedly accessing contextual data to reduce compute overhead and accelerate token generation. At the same time, CPU platforms are increasing core counts and memory channel density, amplifying demand for faster DIMMs and higher aggregate memory bandwidth. Together, these trends are making memory performance and power delivery critical determinants of overall system throughput. The Rambus DDR5 9600 RDIMM chipset directly addresses these requirements, empowering server makers to build scalable platforms capable of supporting next-generation AI infrastructure. “The rapidly accelerating adoption of agentic AI and AI inference workloads is driving unprecedented demand for higher memory bandwidth and capacity in the data center,” said Rami Sethi, SVP and general manager of Memory Interface Chips at Rambus. “With our DDR5 9600 RDIMM chipset featuring the new RCD06, Rambus continues to extend its leadership in high-speed memory interface solutions, enabling our customers to deliver the performance and reliability required for next-generation server platforms.” “As data center architectures evolve to support increasingly complex workloads, memory bandwidth, latency and reliability are becoming critical system-level design considerations,” said Soo Kyoum Kim, associate VP at IDC. “Complete RDIMM chipsets from companies like Rambus address these demands by enabling higher-performance, scalable memory subsystems that can keep pace with next-generation AI and cloud infrastructures.” The Rambus DDR5 9600 RDIMM chipset is a complete solution designed to support next-generation CPU-based server platforms. In addition to the RCD06, the chipset includes the PMIC5030 power management IC , which delivers efficient, high-current power at low voltage levels to support advanced DDR5 RDIMM configurations. The chipset also includes a Serial Presence Detect (SPD) Hub with an integrated temperature sensor, along with dedicated Temperature Sensor ICs , enabling critical module telemetry, configuration and thermal monitoring functions. By integrating clocking, control and power management into a cohesive solution, the chipset ensures robust signal and power integrity at high data rates, reducing design complexity for memory module manufacturers and improving overall system reliability. This level of integration is particularly critical as server architectures scale to support higher processor core counts, larger memory capacity and sustained demands of continuously operating AI workloads. More Information Learn more about the Rambus DDR5 9600 Server RDIMM chipset at https://www.rambus.com/memory-interface-chips/ddr5-dimm-chipset/ . About Rambus Inc. Rambus delivers industry-leading chips and silicon IP for the data center and AI infrastructure. With over three decades of advanced semiconductor experience, our products and technologies address the critical bottlenecks between memory and processing to accelerate data-intensive workloads. By enabling greater bandwidth, efficiency and security across next generation computing platforms, we make data faster and safer. For more information, visit rambus.com . title: CRM Customization: Tailoring Solutions for Optimal Efficiency in 2026
summary: Explore CRM customization options in 2026 for enhanced efficiency and cost savings.
body_text: TL;DR: CRM customization offers tailored solutions to fit specific business workflows, improving efficiency and reducing costs long-term. CRM Customization: Tailoring Solutions for Optimal Efficiency in 2026 Last updated: July 2026 With companies striving for more efficiency in competitive markets, CRM customization is increasingly vital. As Smarter CRMs emerge, businesses seek solutions that align precisely with their needs without incurring unnecessary costs. What are the benefits of CRM customization? CRM customization allows you to adapt the software to match your business processes rather than adjusting your operations to fit the software. This ensures smooth integration with existing workflows, enhances efficiency, and can significantly reduce costs by eliminating unnecessary features and specific per-seat fees. How does CRM customization work? Customization in a CRM system can significantly reshape how a business operates, driving efficiency and aligning the software closely with the company's unique processes. Understanding the elements that comprise CRM customization is the first step in using its potential. At the heart of customization are fields, modules, and user interfaces. Fields are the fundamental data points that CRM systems capture and organize, such as contact information, transaction details, or interaction histories. Customization of fields allows businesses to tailor these entries to reflect the specific data they wish to track, moving beyond generic templates to create a more insightful and relevant data repository. Modules, on the other hand, serve as larger organizational units that can be customized or built from scratch to support distinct business functions such as sales, marketing, or customer service. Customizable modules enable businesses to design workflows that align with their operational procedures rather than forcing processes to fit into predefined structures. Through custom modules, companies can streamline operations, reduce redundancies, and enhance productivity. User interfaces (UI) play a critical role in CRM customization by shaping the way users interact with the system. A tailor-made UI can significantly enhance user experience by presenting data and tools in the most accessible and intuitive formats. Companies may opt to add, remove, or reorder interface elements to better suit the workflows of different teams or departments. This optimization can lead to increased adoption rates and improve the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the CRM system. Integrations and automation are essential in elevating the capabilities of a customized CRM. Integrations involve linking the CRM with other business tools, such as accounting software, e-commerce platforms, or communication apps. These connections enable smooth data flow across systems, reducing manual data entry and potential errors. For instance, integrating a CRM with an email marketing platform can automatically update contact lists based on customer interactions, ensuring marketing campaigns are accurately targeted. Automation enhances CRM functionality by performing routine tasks without manual intervention, allowing teams to focus on strategic work. Examples include automatically assigning leads to appropriate sales reps, generating follow-up reminders post-interaction, or even compiling regular reports on key performance metrics. This level of automation not only saves time but also ensures that critical tasks are consistently completed. Consider custom workflows that simplify complex business processes. For example, a sales team might use a CRM to manage lead nurturing by setting up automated sequences that track lead engagement, trigger follow-up actions based on interactions, and alert sales reps when leads exhibit buying signals. This workflow not only speeds up the sales process but also enhances the lead's journey through personalized engagement. Another hypothetical scenario could involve a customer service department that uses customized workflows to manage support tickets. By automating ticket categorization and prioritization based on complexity and urgency, support teams can reduce response times and improve customer satisfaction. Such workflows embody the practical benefits of CRM customization, demonstrating how systems can be molded to enhance efficiency and effectiveness across various business functions. For businesses intrigued by these possibilities, exploring detailed guides like our Custom CRM Development Software Solutions: A Comprehensive Guide for 2026 can offer further insights into creating tailored solutions. Meanwhile, understanding the interplay between user interfaces and workflow customization is discussed thoroughly in our Understanding Client Management Interfaces: An In-Depth Guide for 2026 . By digging into the customization potential of CRMs, organizations enable the ability to mold their systems precisely around their needs, turning a generalized tool into a powerhouse of productivity tailored to specific business operations. Custom CRM vs Off-the-Shelf Solutions Choosing between a custom CRM and an off-the-shelf solution often hinges on flexibility and cost considerations. Off-the-shelf CRMs are pre-built with a set of standard features designed to meet the average company's needs. They offer some level of customization through extensions or integrations, but these modifications are typically limited. This can lead to inefficiencies in adapting such systems to fit unique workflows. In contrast, a custom CRM provides unparalleled flexibility. Businesses can design every component of the CRM to align with their specific processes and requirements, resulting in a smooth integration tailored entirely to their operations. The financial implications of this choice are significant. While off-the-shelf CRMs generally have lower upfront costs, these savings can be quickly outweighed by ongoing per-seat licensing fees.
